title: Private Delivery Portfolio & Tranche Mapping for Enterprise On‑Prem Features
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Produce a tranche-based delivery map that groups Private/VPC/on-prem capabilities into minimum-viable delivery bundles aligned to customer tiers, regulatory profiles, and OKR milestones. The outcome should enable sales and solutions teams to commit to a migration/activation cadence with clear acceptance gates, rollback points, and observability requirements. This ticket captures scope, tranche boundaries, acceptance criteria, rollout signals, and the cross-functional work required to validate each tranche with pilot customers.
acceptance_criteria: Three named tranches (Core, Compliance, Enterprise Integrations) with a clear set of included features and rationale for ordering
For each tranche, documented external acceptance gates (customer pilot checklist) and internal SLO/observability requirements
Mapping from tranches to OKRs and launch windows for 2026-Q2 and 2026-Q3
Risk and rollback plan for each tranche including required fallbacks and estimated engineering effort
work_items: Define tranche boundaries and owner — owner: Liam O'Connor (PM)
Inventory feature-level prerequisites (RBAC, KMS, audit logging, upgrade tooling) — owner: Platform Eng
Draft pilot acceptance checklist and telemetry signals — owner: Observability team
Create GTM readiness pack for Sales & Solutions — owner: Solutions Enablement
Schedule pilot with 2 anchor accounts for each tranche and capture feedback — owner: Customer Success
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Initial working session held with Eng Leads (serving runtime, infra, security). Agreed on tranche taxonomy: Core / Compliance / Integrations
2026-02-20: Completed feature inventory spreadsheet; flagged upgrade agent and KMS integration as blockers for Compliance tranche
2026-02-28: Observability owner shared draft telemetry signals for activation and rollback; needs alignment on retention windows
2026-03-05: Sales committed two pilot customers for Core tranche (mid-market, fintech). Draft pilot checklist created and attached
decisions: Tranche taxonomy will be outcome-driven (activation risk + regulatory posture) rather than purely feature-size
Core tranche will prioritize installability and minimal security baseline (SSO/KMS optional), postponing complex KMS/HSM integrations to Compliance tranche
Rollout will prefer progressive activation by customer cohort (by industry/regulatory need) instead of all-up big-bang launches
risks: Dependency on on-prem upgrade tooling—if delayed, Compliance tranche timelines slip by one cycle
Telemetry retention costs could push observability budget over allocation for larger pilots
Customer pilot availability constrained by procurement windows (legal/security review) leading to delayed validation
notes: Keep acceptance gates intentionally strict for Compliance tranche — regulatory customers will use these gates as contractual checkpoints.
We will pilot the Core tranche with a non-regulated fintech and a health-tech startup to get contrast on operational expectations.
Follow-up task: convert tranche mapping into roadmap swimlanes for the public roadmap page and sales one-pager.
